document.about: Minutes of the Federal Open Market Committee, January 30–31, 2024 (11 pages). The minutes close on a signature block: the Secretary's name set bold over the role.

notes: 2026-11-24 (#151): a bold line at the body size was a heading whatever followed it. Bold lines in a run with nothing between them, a name over a role at the end or a chart's labels, opened sections that held nothing.

checks.issue: `Joshua Gallin`, the Secretary's name closing the minutes, was a section.
`Secretary` under it was a section of its own.
The last real head, set the same way, must stay.
